changelog:
v1.8.2 Beta
- Corrections typed into a document's source view (YouTube, web pages, PDFs, pasted text) are now really saved. Before, they appeared saved but were lost when the document was reopened. A backup is kept (Restore backup), and if edits can't be saved DocAnalyser says so and copies your text to the clipboard.
- Clarity now uses its own copy of the web engine that draws its window, and the installer blocks that copy from the internet with a firewall rule (Windows asks permission during installation). Nothing else on your computer is affected.

Also new since 1.8.0 (from 1.8.1):
- Works alongside Clarity: right-click a transcript in the Documents Library and choose Open in Clarity. Clarity then edits DocAnalyser's own copy, so both programs always show the same text.
- Safer editing: if a transcript has been changed in another window or in Clarity, DocAnalyser asks before saving over it, and an open window shows the latest version when you come back to it.
- Interviewee approval: changing the words of an approved interview now means its approval needs renewing, and its review copies are marked superseded. Splitting or joining paragraphs, speakers and timings don't count.
- Review copies and timestamped exports check again for names the redactions don't cover.
- Edit in Word notices when the Word copy is out of date and offers a fresh one.
- Import Documents no longer writes over an existing transcript: Rename keeps both, and Overwrite keeps a backup.
- Export Selected exports just the documents you've selected.
